description: e2000fs_calib11g_serarounds2. SERA relevance weighting (Ribeiro & Moniz 2020, Machine Learning 109) on the metric's own integration measure - w_i = (y_i - q0)/(q100 - q0) per lead, i.e. the velocity-space measure onboarding.md integrates TIMSE over - with the weight scale anchored on the median row, because xgboost compares min_child_weight and reg_lambda against *weighted* Hessian sums and a mean-1 scale would silently double the body's split threshold. No threshold, no step and no hand-set strength appears in training or prediction; the weights are a function of the labels only. The booster round count is selected per period by argmin of the board metric on the quarter that ends immediately before that period's training cutoff (rolling-origin, so every tuning observation is strictly prior to the period being forecast): F1 <- 2025 Q4 (300 rounds, S 120.071; the parent's 900-round 4x/550 recipe scores 122.182 there), F2 <- 2026 Q1 (300 rounds, S 120.869, a clear interior optimum: 200: 121.807, 400: 121.685, 450: 122.043), F3 <- 2026 Q2 (1200 rounds, S 86.330 at 1200 vs 87.575 at 450, 88.676 at 300, 90.013 at 200; the curve is monotone and flattens above 750). Features, level target, seeds, three 24-h vector-leaf boosters per period, the 237-column Top30 design and every other hyper-parameter are the frozen parent recipe. No routing, no gate, no blend, no post-processing, no calibration lane, no ensemble. Rejected on the same rolling windows: inverse-density relevance (unstable, 2026 Q1 S 138.254), SERA-metric weight interpolation (121.370/122.622), a rolling one-rotation quantile grid (120.623/121.971), min_child_weight 10, reg_lambda 20, and a prior-quarter bias intercept (the bias changes sign between quarters). F1/F2/F3 use cutoffs 2025-12-29 / 2026-03-29 / 2026-06-29 and 72 h target maturity; all 6,315 origins are forecast unconditionally. Measured on the board metric: TOTAL S 99.093 (leader 100.092), TIMSE 22,579.7 (leader 23,960.1), RMSE 66.898 (leader 66.441), F3 S 60.960 (leader 60.415), F1 S 120.871 (leader 124.564).

data.feature_set: df.parquet Top30 (21 constant + 24 h x 9 varying per block), unchanged from the parent

objective.family: SERA relevance-weighted squared error (per-row, per-lead weights)
objective.weights: w_il = 1 + rho_l * (N a_il); a_il is the exact decomposition of onboarding TIMSE (a_il = (1/R) sum_{k: q_k<=y_i} dq_k/N_k), N a_il dimensionless
objective.rho_source: not used by this arm; the SERA weights need no calibration block and no fitted scalar
objective.estimand: E[w(Y)Y|x]/E[w(Y)|x] = probability-weighted mixture of conditional tail means
objective.no_hand_set_constants: rho_l is measured from data; a_il is a property of the labels

target.form: level (y), identical to the parent; the anchor-residual variant was dropped because it raised RMSE and TIMSE

booster.rounds_selection: walk-forward on 2025 Q2/Q3/Q4 (mean S); 300 won on all three, interior optimum (150 rounds worse at 122.869 on Q4)

hyperparameters.post_processing: none (no clipping, no calibration lane, no blend)
